# The Root Altar

> Transformative tarot readings, spiritual coaching, and powerful ritual work for personal growth, clarity, and healing.

## About

The Root Altar is a spiritual services business founded by Starr Blayze. We offer ethical, transformative spiritual guidance including tarot readings, personal growth coaching, ritual work, candle magic, and love spell rituals. Over 150 clients served with a 5-star average rating.

## Founder

Starr Blayze — Spiritual Coach & Tarot Reader. Specializes in tarot readings (Celtic cross, love, daily pulls), cord cutting rituals, candle magic, and personal growth coaching.

## Services

- **Tarot Readings**: Celtic cross readings, love readings, daily 1-card pulls, Messages from Spirit (incl. finances)
- **Spiritual Coaching**: 1-on-1 personal growth sessions for trauma processing, energetic boundary setting, and self-trust building
- **Ritual Work**: Custom cord cutting ceremonies, cycle-breaking rituals, spiritual cleansing
- **Candle Magic**: Handcrafted 7-day candles, triple action reversible candles, love ritual candles, astral 7x7 candles
- **Love Spell Rituals**: Personal love readings combined with custom ritual work
